# Herma -- the `< 2 ms` context & capability shim for any agent

> Herma (Track 2: Push the Frontier -- Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon 2026): context-shimming AI middleware and capability firewall for configurable coding harnesses -- intercepts requests via keyword, semantic, or micromodel rules to respond directly or shim atomic task objects (nouns), durable tasks (things to do) (verbs), and URI context from a user-configured database before LLM execution ac

- [README.md](https://github.com/ta-amps/herma-infrastructure-shim-for-intelligent-agents/blob/main/README.md): what this is and how to run it
